title: Final Formula
description: Essential Criteria: The student must provide the correct final formula for depth of field, Delta q.

title: Use of Gaussian Formula
description: Important Criteria: The student should correctly apply the Gaussian lens formula in their derivation.

title: Image Distance Relation
description: Important Criteria: The student must derive the relationship between changes in object distance and image distance accurately.

title: Geometric Consideration
description: Important Criteria: The student should incorporate the geometric relationship involving the diameter of the lens and the circle of confusion.

title: Assumption Justification
description: Optional Criteria: The student should justify the assumption that the object distance is much larger than the focal length.

title: Units Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The student should check that all units are consistent throughout the derivation.

title: Common Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must avoid common errors such as sign mistakes in the derivation.

title: Missing Factors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should ensure that all necessary factors, such as the f-stop, are included in the final expression.
